description: This file defines extension methods for the Orleans.Hosting namespace, specifically adding broadcast channel capabilities to silo and client builders. It includes methods for registering broadcast channels and retrieving channel providers, as well as configuring related services.

classes.name: ChannelHostingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to add and configure broadcast channels within Orleans hosting setup.

methods.name: AddBroadcastChannel (ISiloBuilder, string, Action<BroadcastChannelOptions>)
methods.description: Registers a broadcast channel with the silo builder with specific configuration options.

methods.name: AddBroadcastChannel (ISiloBuilder, string, Action<OptionsBuilder<BroadcastChannelOptions>>)
methods.description: Registers a broadcast channel with the silo builder with options builder configuration.

methods.name: AddBroadcastChannel (IClientBuilder, string, Action<BroadcastChannelOptions>)
methods.description: Registers a broadcast channel with the client builder with configuration options.

methods.name: AddBroadcastChannel (IClientBuilder, string, Action<OptionsBuilder<BroadcastChannelOptions>>)
methods.description: Registers a broadcast channel with the client builder with options builder configuration.

methods.name: GetBroadcastChannelProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the broadcast channel provider with the specified name from the cluster client.

methods.name: AddBroadcastChannel (private method)
methods.description: Adds and configures services related to a broadcast channel into the service collection.

calls: services.AddKeyedSingleton(name, (sp, key) => BroadcastChannelProvider.Create(sp, key as string))
